items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1962-02-10
items.q: I was with Herbert Leary's orchestra for about five years during that time.

ctx.x: During that time, did you, I know you wouldn't have given up music, but did you play out in the public at all with any bands or by yourself or… Do you mean before I came to… No, in that period between 1935 when you were raising your family. Oh, yes.

Yes. I just wondered… I was with another band a while and then I played… Which band was if you don't mind? I was with Herbert Leary's orchestra for about five years during that time. And then I played solo at a nightclub, a colored nightclub. Where was that? Which? The Dew Drop.
Oh, yes, right over… I played over there.

items.title: Jeanette Kimball Interview, 1969-06-16
items.q: in the 40s I played with Leary's orchestra for about... I think from 49 to 53

ctx.x: And who did you play with after you quit Solishten in 35? Would you play in any little spots or what?

I played... I was doing mostly teaching then, but in the 40s I played with Leary's orchestra for about... I think from 49 to 53 when I joined, rejoined the Solishten group. And then from 46 to 49 I was playing at the Dewdrop nightclub.
